turns.speaker: rep
turns.name: Jordan Lee
turns.text: Hi, Jordan Lee from Eleno calling for Ethan Clarke at Dockside Dental. We had a three o'clock phone appointment to talk through automating the recall and treatment plan paperwork.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.name: Reception
turns.text: Ethan has been pulled into a patient issue and won't make the call. Sorry, the afternoon has gone sideways on us.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.name: Jordan Lee
turns.text: No worries at all. I will send a short email with two times to reschedule, and he can pick whichever suits. Please let him know Jordan called.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.name: Reception
turns.text: Will do. Email is best today. Thanks for being understanding about it.
